The video segment shows a visual aid used for an educational presentation with the title "STAGE 2: MOTION IN CROSSED FIELDS" displayed prominently at the top. The presentation is divided into two sections, labeled "W.R.T GROUND FRAME" (With Respect To Ground Frame) and "W.R.T FRAME MOVING RIGHTWARDS" (With Respect To Frame Moving Rightwards). On the left side, the diagram illustrates the cycloidal path of a particle, and to the right the path becomes a circle. Textual explanations accompany each diagram, including equations like E = V₀ x B (Electric field equals velocity cross magnetic field) and V₀ = mg / qB (Velocity equals mass times gravity divided by charge times magnetic field), explaining how to convert the cycloidal path into a circular motion by ensuring that gravitational field gets cancelled out. There are no people visible, as the presentation consists entirely of text and diagrams against a black background.

A dashed line depicts a particle's trajectory with a height "h" in a field "B", represented by circled crosses. A formula for the radius R = m*Vrel/qB is shown.
